quotes.text:
RUOLOFAM Ruolo in famiglia 
  Unipersonale 1 
  Genitore in coppia 2 
  Monogenitore 3 
  Coniuge senza figli 4 
  Figlio 5 
  Figlio di monogenitore 6 
  Altro 7
• Si prende cura dei figli e/o di altri familiari non autosufficienti 3|_|
Tali stime si riferiscono a tutti i componenti delle famiglie residenti in Italia al netto dei membri permanenti delle convivenze (ospizi, brefotrofi, istituti religiosi, caserme, ecc.) .

assessments.reasoning: The survey records relationship to the household through variable QSF16 / RUOLOFAM, which categorizes family roles into single person, parent in couple, single parent, spouse without children, child, child of single parent, and other. It does not record member-to-member relationships via a matrix or pointer variables (member_to_member_relationships: false). Beyond basic nuclear family roles, specific extended ties like grandparents, siblings, non-kin, or same-sex partners are not categorized separately (extended_ties: false). The methodological notes define the survey coverage as resident households excluding institutional cohabitations, but do not state criteria for separating multiple households within a single dwelling (multiple_household_criteria: false). Although family roles distinguish children of single parents from other children, the instrument does not establish a framework for identifying distinct sub-units or secondary families within a household (sub_units: false). Finally, while questions such as QC29 ask whether care for children/dependent relatives is a reason for part-time work, the questionnaire does not identify specific caregiving relationships mapping who cares for whom (caregiving_relationships: false).
